title: Florida House, District 63
what_it_does: Represents District 63 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Open seat. Jacqueline Coffie-Leeks won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary over Robin Lockett and Conrad Schupay. Labeled a Democratic primary (not universal), implying a November opponent whose name was not found.
verified_ballot_note: Tampa Bay Times (Aug. 18, 2026): 'HD 63 (Tampa) Democratic Primary: This open seat was won by Jacqueline Coffie-Leeks against Robin Lockett, and Conrad Schupay' (https://www.tampabay.com/news/florida-politics/elections/2026/08/18/florida-legislature-house-senate-legislative-results-primary-2026/). Florida Politics describes HD 63 as inland Hillsborough including Temple Terrace, Sulphur Springs, West Tampa and Ybor City. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
